 Adam Booker · 26 October 2026 
 🎥 Drama galore as LAFC and Galaxy finish level 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article There were major fireworks in Los Angeles as the city's two bitter rivals, LAFC and LA Galaxy finished level in a crucial MLS showdown. 
 LAFC 2 LA Galaxy 2 01:31 The Galaxy had a two-goal lead in the second half and looked well on their way towards a famous victory in the home of their rivals, but Denis Bouanga , Son Heung-min and co. came racing back with two goals of their own. 
 OneFootball Videos
 The major drama came with the final kick of the game when it appeared LAFC had snatched a late winner from a goalmouth scramble, but amid the delirious celebrations inside of BMO Stadium, the referee waved the goal off for a narrow offside in the buildup to the goal. 
 CHAOS IN THE FINAL MINUTE!!! WHAT IS HAPPENING!!  –  Monday, 26 October 2026 
 This rivalry never disappoints and it certainly didn't tonight, yet both teams will feel frustrated to have not taken all three points.
